decided_by: PI ruling following the SDS_G1_4 confirmation
applies_to: all FUTURE search eligibility and all FUTURE confirmations
does_not_apply_to: the SDS_G1_4 confirmation, which stands as FAIL under OBSERVABILITY_V1

OBSERVABILITY_V1.definition: mean(t_intent - t_commit), non-observed event encoded as horizon+1 = 241, gate mean > 0
OBSERVABILITY_V1.history_not_rewritten: V1 is what selected SDS_G1_4 and what scored its confirmation. Those records stand unaltered.
OBSERVABILITY_V1.why_retired: an unobserved event has no event time. Encoding it as the sentinel and averaging with exact observations gives censored episodes enormous artificial leverage, and the statistic did not replicate: +16.625 in development (n=16) versus -17.406 on confirmation (n=32), same construction, different seeds.

estimand: Does BLUE generally have to commit its allocation before RED's strategic intent becomes readable?

classification.rule: event ORDER only; no sentinel value is substituted and no arithmetic is performed on a censored time
classification.ties: t_intent == t_commit is INTENT_FIRST. If intent is readable at the same step commitment becomes due, that does not support precommitment uncertainty.
classification.one_sided_censoring_is_informative_not_m: an episode where RED's intent became readable but BLUE never committed is genuine evidence AGAINST precommitment uncertainty. It is retained as INTENT_FIRST rather than deleted; complete-case deletion would bias the estimate in the opposite direction.

primary_quantity: p_C = P(COMMIT_FIRST) over ALL episodes, UNRESOLVED included in the denominator
unresolved_handling: counted in the denominator, never in the numerator, so UNRESOLVED weighs against the gate. An episode that resolved neither event is not evidence that commitment came first.

bootstrap.procedure: percentile bootstrap on the COMMIT_FIRST 0/1 indicator
bootstrap.consistent_with: the same procedure and constant used by the M1 assay and the SDS_G1_4 confirmation

demoted_to_telemetry.why: prevents a candidate from passing because a few censor-coded episodes each contributed +230

validation_includes: the full classification truth table as ruled
insensitivity to how late a censored episode's other event is -- the case that broke V1
UNRESOLVED counts against the gate and is never deleted
p_C = 0.5 exactly must FAIL (gate is strictly greater)
a reconstruction of the SDS_G1_4 confirmation shape, asserting V1 goes negative while V2 does not
a single censored episode can move p_C by at most 1/n

descriptive_only_reading_of_existing_dat.status: TELEMETRY. Does NOT re-score the SDS_G1_4 confirmation, which remains FAIL under V1.
descriptive_only_reading_of_existing_dat.why_recorded: it targets the next search, and it is reported because it cuts AGAINST the current candidate rather than for it

A_pole_SDS_G1_4.note: lands exactly on the boundary and the gate is strictly greater. V2 does NOT rescue this candidate.

descriptive_only_reading_of_existing_dat.the_asymmetry_that_matters: intent observation rate is 0.938 against SDS_G1_4 versus 0.344 against OP7. OP7 already conceals; SDS_G1_4 telegraphs. The concealment problem is specific to the A pole, which is where the next search must work.
descriptive_only_reading_of_existing_dat.caveat: these numbers come from data already seen and are not a V2 result. A V2 claim requires a fresh untouched block.

episode_count_RATIFIED.why_64: 0.89 power at true p_C 0.70 and 0.98 at 0.75, versus 0.60 and 0.87 at n=32. n=96 buys about 9 further points at p_C 0.70 for 50% more episodes, which has not been earned yet.

power_simulation.method: 400 simulated confirmations per cell, binomial draws at each true p_C, scored with the frozen V2 gate

episode_count_RATIFIED.no_extension_rule: confirmation is 64 from the start. No peeking at 32 and deciding to extend to 64 or 96. If it fails at 64, it fails. A rescue extension would convert a fixed-n test into an optional-stopping procedure and destroy the error rate.

AMENDED.why: power analysis on the actual candidate's payoff margin; prospective, before any confirmation episode

development_ladder_RATIFIED.n_8_retired: n=8 is RETIRED for the observability gate. Small-sample ordering estimates proved unstable: that is how SDS_G1_4 was promoted on a statistic that later reversed sign.
